fields.label: Harvest user id (OAuth sub / Site Admin)

jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/boards/{boardToken}/jobs.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single Harvest job via authenticated GET /v3/jobs/{id}. Distinct from boards jobs.list.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/candidates. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, updatedBefore/After, jobId, email, and candidateIds filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/candidates/{id}.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/applications. Optional perPage, page, createdBefore/After, lastActivityAfter, jobId, and status filters.

applications.get.title: Get application
applications.get.description: Fetch a single application via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/applications/{id}.

applications.move.title: Move application
applications.move.description: Move an application to another interview stage (or transfer to another job) via authenticated Harvest POST /v3/applications/{id}/move. Requires fromStageId matching the current stage. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes the post-move application via applications.get (move itself returns 204).

fromStageId.description: Current job interview stage id; must match the application's current stage.

toStageId.description: Destination stage id within the same job.

toJobId.description: Destination job id when transferring the application to another job.

emailFromUserId.description: Optional user id used as the from address for stage-transition emails.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

applications.create.title: Create application
applications.create.description: Create an application for an existing candidate via authenticated Harvest POST /v3/applications. Requires candidateId and jobId. Effect keys omitted (creates always omit).

candidateId.description: Harvest candidate id to attach the application to.

jobId.description: Harvest job id for the candidate application.

initialStageId.description: Optional job interview stage id to place the application in.

sourceId.description: Optional source id credited for this application.

application.description: Normalized application after reconcile via applications.get.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List users via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/users. Optional perPage, page, email, employeeId, and created/updated before/after filters.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/interviews (v1: scheduled_interviews). Optional perPage, page, applicationId, jobId, and created/updated before/after filters.

job_interview_stages.list.title: List job interview stages
job_interview_stages.list.description: List job interview stages via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/job_interview_stages. Optional perPage, jobIds, ids, and active filters. Supports move-stage workflows.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Mint an OAuth client-credentials token then GET /v3/users?per_page=1 (proves Bearer auth and optional Site Admin sub).

candidates.create.title: Create candidate
candidates.create.description: Create a candidate via authenticated Harvest POST /v3/candidates. Requires firstName and lastName. Optional email maps to email_addresses; optional jobId attaches an application. Effect keys omitted (creates always omit).

email.description: Primary personal email; sent as Harvest email_addresses[0].

phone.description: Primary mobile phone; sent as Harvest phone_numbers[0].

jobId.description: Optional Harvest job id; sent as applications[0].job_id.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after EffectPolicy Idempotent via candidates.get.

candidates.update.title: Update candidate
candidates.update.description: Update a candidate via authenticated Harvest PATCH /v3/candidates/{id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via candidates.get.

candidate.description: Normalized candidate after EffectPolicy Reconcile via candidates.get.

offers.list.title: List offers
offers.list.description: List offers via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/offers. Optional perPage, page, jobId, applicationId, and status filters.

offers.get.title: Get offer
offers.get.description: Fetch a single offer via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/offers/{id}.

scorecards.list.title: List scorecards
scorecards.list.description: List interview scorecards via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/scorecards. Optional perPage, page, applicationId, and jobId filters.

scorecards.get.title: Get scorecard
scorecards.get.description: Fetch a single scorecard via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/scorecards/{id}.

departments.list.title: List departments
departments.list.description: List departments via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/departments.

offices.list.title: List offices
offices.list.description: List offices via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/offices.

sources.list.title: List sources
sources.list.description: List candidate sources via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/sources.

close_reasons.list.title: List close reasons
close_reasons.list.description: List application close reasons via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/close_reasons.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch a single user via authenticated Harvest GET /v3/users/{id}.

applications.reject.title: Reject application
applications.reject.description: Reject an application (POST /v3/applications/{id}/reject). rejectionReasonId is required on Harvest v3.

application.description: Normalized application after EffectPolicy Reconcile via applications.get.

applications.hire.title: Hire application
applications.hire.description: Mark an application as hired via POST /v3/applications/{id}/hire (204). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get.

applications.update.title: Update application
applications.update.description: Patch application attribution/metadata via PATCH /v3/applications/{id}. customFields is the Harvest v3 array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value }. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via applications.get.

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears).

application_stages.list.title: List application stages
application_stages.list.description: List application stage history rows via GET /v3/application_stages (agent tool).

notes.create.title: Create note
notes.create.description: Create a candidate note/email/activity via POST /v3/notes. Visibility create enums: admin_only|private|public. Effect keys omitted (no note.get).

authorUserId.description: Optional note author (Harvest user id); wired as user_id.

emailCc.description: EMAIL Cc addresses (required array for EMAIL, may be empty).

notes.list.title: List notes
notes.list.description: List notes via GET /v3/notes (agent tool). List visibility filter uses *_visible enums.

candidateIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

candidate_tags.list.description: List org candidate-tag dictionary via GET /v3/candidate_tags (agent tool).

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

candidates.apply_tag.title: Apply candidate tag
candidates.apply_tag.description: Apply a tag to a candidate via POST /v3/applied_candidate_tags. Input id is the candidate id. Effect keys omitted (POST creates a join row; candidates.get returns tag names, not candidate_tag_id, so no exact observe).

candidates.remove_tag.title: Remove applied candidate tag
candidates.remove_tag.description: Detach an applied candidate tag via DELETE /v3/applied_candidate_tags/{id}. id is the applied-tag row id.

interviews.create.title: Create interview
interviews.create.description: Schedule an interview via POST /v3/interviews. Each interviewer requires responseStatus plus exactly one of userId/email/employeeId. Effect keys omitted.

interviews.update.title: Update interview
interviews.update.description: Patch a scheduled interview via PATCH /v3/interviews/{id}. Effect keys omitted.

offers.create.title: Create offer
offers.create.description: Create an offer via POST /v3/offers. Returns the created offer (top-level id). customFields is the Harvest v3 array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value }. Effect keys omitted (creates always omit).

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears).

jobs.list_internal.title: List jobs (Harvest internal)
jobs.list_internal.description: List Harvest jobs via GET /v3/jobs (agent tool). Singular departmentId/officeId filters. Distinct from public boards jobs.list.

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

candidates.merge.title: Merge candidates
candidates.merge.description: Merge secondaryCandidateId into the primary candidate id via POST /v3/candidates/{id}/merge. The secondary candidate is permanently deleted. Returns the surviving primary candidate. Effect keys omitted (merge is not observable via candidates.get).

secondaryCandidateId.description: Candidate id to merge into the primary; permanently deleted.

candidates.delete.title: Delete candidate
candidates.delete.description: Permanently delete candidate via DELETE /v3/candidates/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted. Also deletes all of the candidate's applications, attachments, scorecards and notes.

applications.delete.title: Delete application
applications.delete.description: Permanently delete application via DELETE /v3/applications/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted. Also deletes its interview stages, scorecards and rejection details; the candidate is kept.

attachments.list.title: List attachments
attachments.list.description: List application attachments via GET /v3/attachments (agent tool). url is a time-limited signed link.

applicationIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

candidateIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

attachments.create.title: Create attachment
attachments.create.description: Attach a file to an application via POST /v3/attachments (JSON, not multipart). Provide exactly one of content (base64) or url. Returns the created attachment (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

content.description: Base64-encoded file contents (exactly one of content or url).

url.description: Publicly fetchable URL Greenhouse downloads (exactly one of content or url).

visibility.description: Optional visibility; inferred from type when omitted.

attachments.delete.title: Delete attachment
attachments.delete.description: Permanently delete attachment via DELETE /v3/attachments/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted.

candidate_educations.list.title: List candidate educations
candidate_educations.list.description: List candidate education entries via GET /v3/candidate_educations (agent tool).

candidateIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

latest.description: When true, only each candidate's latest education.

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

candidate_educations.create.title: Create candidate education
candidate_educations.create.description: Add an education entry via POST /v3/candidate_educations. Use startDate/endDate (YYYY-MM-DD) or the month/year pairs per side, not both. Returns the created entry (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

startDate.description: Optional start date (YYYY-MM-DD); not with startDateMonth/startDateYear.

endDate.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD); not with endDateMonth/endDateYear.

candidate_educations.delete.title: Delete candidate education
candidate_educations.delete.description: Permanently delete candidate education entry via DELETE /v3/candidate_educations/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted.

candidate_employments.list.title: List candidate employments
candidate_employments.list.description: List candidate employment entries via GET /v3/candidate_employments (agent tool).

candidateIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

latest.description: When true, only each candidate's latest employment.

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

cursor.description: Harvest v3 cursor from Link rel=next.

candidate_employments.create.title: Create candidate employment
candidate_employments.create.description: Add a work-history entry via POST /v3/candidate_employments. Omit endDate for current employment. Returns the created entry (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

candidate_employments.delete.title: Delete candidate employment
candidate_employments.delete.description: Permanently delete candidate employment entry via DELETE /v3/candidate_employments/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted.

candidate_tags.create.title: Create candidate tag
candidate_tags.create.description: Add a tag to the organization's candidate-tag dictionary via POST /v3/candidate_tags. Names are unique (case sensitive); duplicates return 422. Returns the created tag (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

candidate_tags.delete.title: Delete candidate tag
candidate_tags.delete.description: Permanently delete candidate tag via DELETE /v3/candidate_tags/{id}. Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted. Also removes the tag from every candidate it was applied to.

rejection_details.update.title: Update rejection detail
rejection_details.update.description: Patch the rejection reason or rejection-question custom fields via PATCH /v3/rejection_details/{id} (id is the rejection-detail row id, not the application id). rejected_at is unchanged. Effect keys omitted (no single-GET observe).

customFields.description: Optional rejection-question values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value }.

jobs.create.title: Create job
jobs.create.description: Create a job from a template via POST /v3/jobs. templateJobId and numberOfOpenings are required; the template supplies the interview plan, scorecards, hiring team and approvals. Returns the created job (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

openingIds.description: Optional partner opening ids (at most numberOfOpenings).

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears). Replaces the collection wholesale.

jobs.update.title: Update job
jobs.update.description: Patch a job via PATCH /v3/jobs/{id}. Only supplied keys change; officeIds and customFields replace wholesale; null clears requisitionId/departmentId/anywhere. Open/close via openings. Effect keys omitted (jobs.get is not an exact observe).

anywhere.description: Whether the job can be performed anywhere (null clears).

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears). Replaces the collection wholesale.

job_posts.list.title: List job posts
job_posts.list.description: List candidate-facing job posts via GET /v3/job_posts (agent tool).

jobIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

jobBoardIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

ids.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

openings.create.title: Create opening
openings.create.description: Add an opening to a job via POST /v3/openings. Returns the created opening (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears). Replaces the collection wholesale.

openings.update.title: Update opening
openings.update.description: Patch an opening via PATCH /v3/openings/{id}; status closed closes it (closing the last open opening closes the job). customFields replaces wholesale. Effect keys omitted (no opening.get).

customFields.description: Optional Harvest v3 custom field values: array of { name_key | custom_field_id, value } (exactly one of name_key/custom_field_id per entry; value null clears). Replaces the collection wholesale.

job_owners.create.title: Create job owner
job_owners.create.description: Add a user to a job's hiring team as recruiter, coordinator or sourcer via POST /v3/job_owners. Returns the join row (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

ownerUserId.description: Harvest user id to assign; wired as user_id.

job_owners.delete.title: Delete job owner
job_owners.delete.description: Remove a user from one hiring-team role via DELETE /v3/job_owners/{id} (id is the job_owners row id). Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted.

job_hiring_managers.list.description: List job hiring managers via GET /v3/job_hiring_managers (agent tool).

userIds.description: Optional Harvest ids filter (comma string or array).

job_hiring_managers.create.title: Create job hiring manager
job_hiring_managers.create.description: Assign a hiring manager to a job via POST /v3/job_hiring_managers. Returns the join row (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

hiringManagerUserId.description: Harvest user id to assign; wired as user_id.

job_hiring_managers.delete.title: Delete job hiring manager
job_hiring_managers.delete.description: Unassign a hiring manager via DELETE /v3/job_hiring_managers/{id} (id is the job_hiring_managers row id). Returns { ok: true }; 404 surfaces as CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Effect keys omitted.

job_notes.create.description: Create a note on a job via POST /v3/job_notes. Returns the created note (top-level id). Effect keys omitted.

authorUserId.description: Note author (Harvest user id); wired as user_id.

job_notes.update.title: Update job note
job_notes.update.description: Patch a job note via PATCH /v3/job_notes/{id} (body and/or visibility). Effect keys omitted (no job_note.get).
